definitions.explanation: The specific model or type of a vehicle. Used when talking about choosing, comparing, or identifying different cars.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}の{車種|しゃしゅ}はどれですか。
レンタカーの{車種|しゃしゅ}を{選|えら}んでください。
examples.english: Please choose the type of rental car.

examples.japanese: {保険料|ほけんりょう}は{車種|しゃしゅ}によって{大|おお}きく{異|こと}なる。
examples.english: Insurance premiums vary greatly depending on the car model.

notes: Used broadly for any type of vehicle classification, not just brand. Common collocations include {車種|しゃしゅ}を{選|えら}ぶ (choose a car model), {人気|にんき}{車種|しゃしゅ} (popular model), and {対象|たいしょう}{車種|しゃしゅ} (applicable vehicle types). In rental car and insurance contexts, {車種|しゃしゅ} often refers to size class (compact, sedan, SUV, etc.).
